description: Find redundant CI matrix combinations: combos whose runs always pass and whose coverage is fully exercised by other combos that stay, from caller-supplied run history.

combos.description: Matrix combinations in the CI matrix (at least one)

dimensions.description: Dimension values for this combination, e.g. {"os": "linux", "node": "20"} (optional, default {})

combo.description: Id of the combination this run exercised

covered.description: Coverage keys this run exercised, e.g. test files or feature ids (optional, default [])

name: find_redundant_combos
